summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing routine ASX-mandated daily transaction reporting under its existing stock repurchase program, which authorizes up to $1 billion in aggregate purchases of Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock. Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 reproduce the disclosures provided to the Australian Securities Exchange on the dates noted. No specific daily purchase volumes, share counts, or prices are detailed in the excerpt. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or closing condition is stated. What to watch: actual buyback pace and capital deployment signals.
